Bekannte Anliegen löst du eigenständig, komplexere Fälle grenzt du strukturiert ein, übergibst sie qualifiziert an interne IT oder externe Dienstleister und verfolgst sie bis zur Lösung. Ein Remote-Setting ist bei entsprechender Reisebereitschaft zu unseren bundesweiten Praxisstandorten möglich. Systematische Eingrenzung komplexerer Probleme sowie qualifizierte Koordination mit interner IT, externen IT-Dienstleistern und Praxisverantwortlichen, wenn eine Eskalation oder Vor-Ort-Lösung erforderlich ist. What you need to succeed Solides technisches Grundverständnis für gängige Anwendungen, Geräte und grundlegende IT-Themen sowie die Bereitschaft zu bundesweiten Dienstreisen (ca. 30% der Arbeitszeit). Erfahrung im IT-Support, technischen Customer Support oder einer vergleichbaren Service-Rolle mit direktem Kontakt zu Endnutzer:innen . Strukturierte Problemlösung und Ownership: Du grenzt Anliegen durch gezielte Fragen ein, löst bekannte Fälle eigenständig und begleitest komplexere Themen über eine qualifizierte Eskalation bis zur Lösung. Sorgfalt im Ticketing sowie Freude daran, wiederkehrende Probleme nachvollziehbar zu dokumentieren und in Wissensartikel, Standards oder bessere Abläufe zu überführen. Nice to have: Erfahrung mit Praxisverwaltungssystemen, Healthcare-IT, Telematikinfrastruktur, Account-Verwaltung oder externen IT-Dienstleistern. Why Vantis Purpose & Impact: Als Teil eines jungen Unternehmens gestaltest du die Gesundheitsversorgung von morgen aktiv mit und verbesserst damit die Versorgung von zehntausenden Patient:innen. Inklusive Teamkultur: Bei Vantis zählt der Beitrag jeder einzelnen Person, wir kommunizieren offen und transparent und feiern kleine wie große Erfolge gemeinsam - sei es beim After-Work oder auf dem Oktoberfest. Gesunde Balance: Mit Mittagszuschuss, ermäßigter Wellpass-Mitgliedschaft, flexiblen Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und frischen Snacks im Büro bleibt dein Alltag ausgewogen und energiegeladen. Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: In einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen erwarten dich beste Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten, von einer steilen Lernkurve über den Wissensaustausch zwischen unseren Teams bis hin zu einem personalisierten Weiterbildungsangebot. Durch die Kombination digitaler Behandlungswege und einer maßgeschneiderten, patientenzentrierten Versorgung vor Ort. Wenn du Lust hast, die Zukunft der Medizin mitzugestalten und Teil eines dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Teams zu werden, bist du bei uns genau richtig!

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Inference Systems
review_candidates.description: We are seeking highly skilled and motivated software engineers to join us and build AI inference systems that serve large-scale models with extreme efficiency. You’ll architect and implement high-performance inference stacks, optimize GPU kernels and compilers, drive industry benchmarks, and scale workloads across multi-GPU, multi-node, and multi-cloud environments. You’ll collaborate across inference, compiler, scheduling, and performance teams to push the frontier of accelerated computing for AI. What You’ll Be Doing Contribute features to vLLM that empower the newest models with the latest NVIDIA GPU hardware features; profile and optimize the inference framework (vLLM) with methods like speculative decoding, data/tensor/expert/pipeline-parallelism, prefill-decode disaggregation. Develop, optimize, and benchmark GPU kernels (hand-tuned and compiler-generated) using techniques such as fusion, autotuning, and memory/layout optimization; build and extend high-level DSLs and compiler infrastructure to boost kernel developer productivity while approaching peak hardware utilization. Define and build inference benchmarking methodologies and tools; contribute both new benchmark and NVIDIA’s submissions to the industry-leading MLPerf Inference benchmarking suite. Architect the scheduling and orchestration of containerized large-scale inference deployments on GPU clusters across clouds. Conduct and publish original research that pushes the pareto frontier for the field of ML Systems; survey recent publications and find a way to integrate research ideas and prototypes into NVIDIA’s software products. What We Need To See Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent expeience) in Computer Science (CS), Computer Engineering (CE) or Software Engineering (SE) with 7+ years of experience; alternatively, Master’s degree in CS/CE/SE with 5+ years of experience; or PhD degree with the thesis and top-tier publications in ML Systems, GPU architecture, or high-performance computing. Strong programming skills in Python and C/C++; experience with Go or Rust is a plus; solid CS fundamentals: algorithms & data structures, operating systems, computer architecture, parallel programming, distributed systems, deep learning theories. Knowledgeable and passionate about performance engineering in ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch) and inference engines (e.g., vLLM and SGLang). Familiarity with GPU programming and performance: CUDA, memory hierarchy, streams, NCCL; proficiency with profiling/debug tools (e.g., Nsight Systems/Compute). Experience with containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Slurm); familiarity with Linux namespaces and cgroups. Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills; ability to excel in a fast-paced, multi-functional setting. Ways to stand out from the crowd Experience building and optimizing LLM inference engines (e.g., vLLM, SGLang). Hands-on work with ML compilers and DSLs (e.g., Triton, TorchDynamo/Inductor, MLIR/LLVM, XLA), GPU libraries (e.g., CUTLASS) and features (e.g., CUDA Graph, Tensor Cores). Experience contributing to containerization/virtualization technologies such as containerd/CRI-O/CRIU. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP/Azure), infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production observability. Contributions to open-source projects and/or publications; please include links to GitHub pull requests, published papers and artifacts. At NVIDIA, we believe artificial intelligence (AI) will fundamentally transform how people live and work. Our mission is to advance AI research and development to create groundbreaking technologies that enable anyone to harness the power of AI and benefit from its potential. Our team consists of experts in AI, systems and performance optimization. Our leadership includes world-renowned experts in AI systems who have received multiple academic and industry research awards. If you’re excited to build systems, kernels, and tools that make large-scale AI faster, more efficient, and easier to deploy, we’d love to hear from you. Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. You're comfortable operating autonomously with appropriate support with limited regional infrastructure, working effectively across time zones and global teams. review_candidates.title: Sr. Data Scientist
review_candidates.description: Description The Senior Data Scientist will support the Department of State (DOS), Bureau of Population, Refugees, and Migration (PRM), with advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, data visualization, and data management activities. The position will analyze complex datasets to identify trends, develop forecasts, support programmatic and financial reporting, and provide data-driven insights for government officials, policymakers, and other stakeholders. The Senior Data Scientist will also support the development of databases, dashboards, data dictionaries, and analytical documentation while collaborating with stakeholders to identify business questions, establish data-driven solutions, and communicate findings to technical and nontechnical audiences. Duties and Responsibilities Perform advanced data analysis and visualization, including trend analysis, predictive analysis, and forecasting. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify quantifiable questions and develop data-driven solutions. Standardize, manage, and visualize partner programmatic and financial reporting within a centralized database and dashboard environment. Support the development of a unified, data-driven understanding of global populations of concern using publicly available data and self-service humanitarian contextual dashboards. Communicate analytical findings and insights to government officials, policymakers, and the general public. Develop and maintain data management systems, databases, data dictionaries, dashboards, and supporting documentation. Support other priority data analytics and reporting requirements identified by DOS and PRM. Apply data management best practices related to data quality, security, privacy, governance, and documentation. Collaborate across organizations to establish consensus and support system authorization activities. Manage time and resources effectively while maintaining established work standards and quality requirements. Requirements Required Skills: Bachelor’s degree or higher in statistics, computer science, mathematics, data science, information systems, or a related discipline. Min 5 years, 10 yr preferred of experience in data science, statistical modeling, machine learning, or a related field. Proficiency in Python, R, and SQL. Experience developing complex analytical models using large or complex datasets. Experience performing trend analysis, predictive analysis, forecasting, statistical modeling, and data visualization. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization platforms. Knowledge of data management best practices, including data quality, security, privacy, governance, and documentation. Experience developing or maintaining databases, data management systems, data dictionaries, dashboards, and analytical documentation. Experience analyzing and visualizing programmatic and financial reporting data. Ability to communicate analytical findings to technical and nontechnical audiences, including government officials and policymakers. Experience collaborating across organizations to define requirements, establish consensus, and support system authorization activities. DOS experience is preferred, particularly supporting PRM, international affairs, humanitarian assistance, refugee affairs, or foreign policy programs. Ability to obtain and maintain a Secret security clearance and meet DOS system-access and badging requirements. Salary Description $150,000 - $165,000
